jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Septem Systems is actively looking for skilled and experienced 𝐅𝐮𝐥𝐥 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐌𝐄𝐑𝐍 𝐒𝐨𝐟𝐭𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐄𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬-𝐨𝐧 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐍𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐉𝐒 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐌𝐲𝐒𝐐𝐋. Join our growing engineering team to build scalable web applications, solve real-world problems, and contribute to products that make a difference!

𝐋𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Queen’s Road, Lahore

𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞: 2-3 Years

𝐉𝐨𝐛 𝐓𝐲𝐩𝐞: Full-Time, 𝐎𝐍𝐒𝐈𝐓𝐄.

𝐎𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬:

  • Develop, test, and deploy modern web applications using 𝐌𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐨𝐃𝐁, 𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬.𝐣𝐬, 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐭.𝐣𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐍𝐨𝐝𝐞.𝐣𝐬.
  • Work on 𝐑𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐀𝐏𝐈𝐬 and 𝐦𝐢𝐜𝐫𝐨 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐞𝐬 with 𝐍𝐞𝐬𝐭.𝐣𝐬
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver new features.
  • Optimize application performance and ensure responsiveness across devices.
  • Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and deployment processes.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack.

𝐑𝐞𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬:

  • 𝟐–𝟒 𝐲𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬 of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer.
  • Strong knowledge of the 𝐌𝐄𝐑𝐍 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐜𝐤 (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)
  • Hands-on 𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐍𝐞𝐬𝐭.𝐣𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 and databases like 𝐌𝐲𝐒𝐐𝐋.
  • Proficient in 𝐉𝐚𝐯𝐚𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐭 and 𝐓𝐲𝐩𝐞𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐭
  • Understanding of 𝐑𝐄𝐒𝐓 𝐀𝐏𝐈𝐬, authentication (JWT/OAuth), and modern development tools (Git, Postman, Docker, etc.)
  • Experience with 𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧 and 𝐪𝐮𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐨𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧
  • Good understanding of software engineering best practices, including testing and CI/CD

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, send your resume now! Let’s build something amazing together!
